scope: Packed Equation (25) matrix/conjugation factors directly feed a resident DD product tree. Sequential and concurrent hybrid prime submission compiled. Host metadata tests pass normal and UBSan; device arithmetic/reference execution and full refresh integration remain unverified.
leaf_delta_contract: Caller supplies encoded-table scale in tree.leaves; ProductTree validates its multiplication scale/drop propagation. Packed matrix descriptor does not encode plaintext scale.
concurrent_order: Each factor gates both prime streams behind prior join work using begin; inverse-prime completion joins CRT/conjugation; product tree follows on join. Same caller streams/events reused across factors.
partial_submission_cleanup_contract: Caller synchronizes all involved streams before reusing/freeing buffers. In-place coefficient tables must be restored before subsequent evaluation.
ubsan_scope: Current CUDA host source and test compiled with undefined sanitizer; unchanged host-instrumented Tensor Core object reused. Device code/runtime uninstrumented; device paths unexecuted.
